text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Second round of local elections repeated in Macedonia with minor incidents. Opposition ehtnic Albanian party PDPA had several complaints in Tetovo.

- Macedonians celebrated the national St Clement Day. Speaking at the central celebration in St Clement's church in Skopje Macedonian archbishop Mihail referred to the "importance of this day for the identity of the Macedonian people and the establishment of their church."
- Macedonian Foreign Minister Ljubomir Frckoski is visiting Canada where he will meet Canadian Foreign ministry officials and a number of Macedonian emigrant organisations.

- Second round of local elections in Tetovo to be held December 22 because of irregularities. Strongest competition for mayor is between candidates of the Albanian PDP, a member of the ruling coalition, and opposition PDPA parties.
- In the shade of local elections several managers of companies in Stip dismissed by workers. The reason is deep dissatisfaction and irregularities during the privatisation process.
